title: Publish the project
details: The repository is public at github.com/codesweep-ai/npmrevs, and main is pushed. The five ghcr.io packages are public already: ghcr.io gives a package the visibility of the repository its source label names. The site is live at codesweep.ai/npmrevs, the five npm packages are published, and npm.yml publishes each commit on main under the dev tag, so trusted publishing works. npmrevs is on the CI dashboard. What remains. Set each npm package to require two-factor authentication and disallow tokens, if that is not set already. Tag v0.1.0, publish the draft release goreleaser leaves behind, and run make npm-publish: until a release is published, the latest tag names a dev build. The move-to-npmrevs branches of ledger and ui merge last; lint's has merged already.
